howEachLeverIsBuilt.a: the job state already reaches the core as JobSnapshot.stateCode (printed on the staff job card); the shortcut is a six-value type and a lookup table in the service (one file), the clean path a new core type, a port field and an adapter mapping
howEachLeverIsBuilt.b: the steps name the states posted, claimed, drafting, proofreading, delivered, disputed
howEachLeverIsBuilt.c: the core keeps the marketplace's two turnaround speeds one to one (standard / express for normal / express; legal: two values)
howEachLeverIsBuilt.d: step 3 (proofreading) is one more entry in the six-value table, a new progress value and a mapping change on the clean tree; step 2 (invoice) is one comparison on the copied value
howEachLeverIsBuilt.e: the portal wants upper-case stage words; two of them (DELIVERED, PROOFREADING) are the marketplace's own words
howEachLeverIsBuilt.f: four office-side features (16 more files: glossaries, credit lines, closing days, style guides); the marketplace ports sit under ports/out/marketplace, the service under services/jobs
